results.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

results.name: Barbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back, squeezing your shoulder blades and raising your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the bar by straightening your legs, and take a step back.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

results.name: Barbell Step Up
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

results.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and push your heels into the floor.
Try to extend your knees and hips simultaneously.

results.name: Barbell High Bar Squat
steps: Place the bar on top of your traps.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts
steps: Stand with a barbell at your shins with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend forward at your hips and keep your knees as fully extended as possible.
Grab the barbell and then extend your hips while maintaining a straight back.
From the standing position, lower the weight in a controlled manner.
You can either lower the weight to the floor or before you touch the floor, depending on your mobility.

results.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

results.name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

results.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
steps: Pull your shoulder blades back really hard and place the bar on your posterior delts.
Push your hips back and break at the knees to initiate the squat.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the ground. Push your heels into the floor and squat back up to a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Staggered Deadlift
steps: Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Front Squat Bodybuilding
steps: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
steps: Place the bar between your traps and rear delts. Pull your shoulder blades back to give the bar a shelf to sit on.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. This means you're nearing the end of your Range of Motion with out rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you'e in a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Front Squat Olympic
steps: Measure your hands by the markings on the bar to make sure you're even. Then throw your elbows underneath the bar.
The bar should be set so high on your shoulders it digs into your neck a bit. Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Start by pushing your hips straight back and extending your non-working leg behind you. It is ok to touch your other foot back to the ground each rep.
Leave your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstring. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Barbell High Bar Good Morning
steps: Place the bar on your traps. You may need a pad so the bar doesn't dig into your cervical spine.
Push your hips straight back. Your knees should stay MOSTLY extended (think soft knees). Also make sure to
Look for what feels like a stretch in your hamstrings. The stretch feeling means you're likely nearing the end of your Range of Motion without rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're in a standing position.

results.name: Ez Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Ez Bar Zercher Squat
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

results.name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold trap bar, stand tall with slight knee bend.
Hinge hips back, lowering bar along thighs.
Keep back neutral and tension in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

results.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground. Place a barbell across your hips and grasp it with both hands.
Keeping your arms straight, push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground and raise the barbell.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, then slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Heels Up Back Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your heels on a plate or low step.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Heels Up Front Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and feet on a plate. Place the bar in a front rack position.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your heels raised off the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step out to the side with your right foot and bend your right knee to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

results.name: Barbell Pause Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

results.name: Barbell Pause Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, pausing for a moment at the bottom of the movement before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor behind you, with the weight plates on either side.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Side Step Up
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor in front of you, with the weight plates on either side. Make sure that the bar is directly in line with your feet.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands much wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the ground, making sure to keep your back straight and your shoulders down throughout the movement.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Grip Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart. The bar should be in a rack or box so it's lifted off the ground.
Grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands should be much wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hing forward at the hips keeping your knees mostly extended. Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Split Squat
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Step Up Balance
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

results.name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a barbell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell down towards the ground.
As the barbell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the barbell on the opposite side of your body.

results.name: Barbell Tap Pause Squat
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Sit back and lower your body down until your glutes tap the top of the box, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand up, bringing your body back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Zercher Good Morning
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Zercher Squat
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips, and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Raise one leg up and off the box.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Place one foot about 6-9 inches in front of the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist
steps: Set up the landmine attachment and load weight.
Stand facing the landmine, holding the weight away from your chest.
Step backward with one leg, lunge down while twisting your torso toward the front leg, return to starting position, and repeat on the other side.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine with feet hip-width apart and holding the end of the landmine barbell with both hands, keeping elbows bent and close to your body.
Step backward with the right foot, lunge down, and press the landmine away from your chest.
Push through the left heel to return to the starting position while pulling the landmine back to your chest.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar at your side with one hand.
With the leg on the same side of your body as the barbell, lunge backward and across your body at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to lower your back knee gently to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Glute Kick Back
steps: Start on your hands and knees perpendicular to the barbell with the end of the barbell resting on the inside of your knee that is closer to the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a
degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the barbell.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar in the goblet position in front of your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Step backward and across your body with one leg at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to gently lower your back knee to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back up and to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching legs.

results.name: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge
steps: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar close to your chest in the goblet position with your elbows tucked in close to your body.

Step directly out to the side with both toes pointing forward. Keep your weight on the heel of the leg you step out with as you sink down over that foot while your other leg remains straight for balance.
Drive through the heel over which you have centered your body as you step back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Hack Squat
steps: Start facing away from the landmine attachment with the end of the barbell resting on one shoulder against the base of your neck while leaning slightly back into the weight of the barbell.

Squat down with control while keeping the weight of the barbell as close to centered over your midpoint as possible, then drive through your heels to stand all the way back up and return to starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch the side of your body the barbell is on every subsequent set.

results.name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand facing the landmine with your feet shoulder width apart while holding the end of the barbell in your hands with your arms fully extended down towards the ground.
While keeping your torso tall and core engaged, step directly out to one side, using the foot you have stepped out with to sit down into the lunge while keeping your other leg straight.
Drive through your heel on your bent leg as your step together to return to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps on the same side before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Lunge
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, holding it at at your side with your palm facing in towards your leg.

Take a step backward with your foot on the same side that you're holding the barbell, lowering your body into a lunge position. Bend both knees to lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows. Keep your torso upright, your chest lifted, and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine attachment while holding the end of the bar with one hand at your shoulder on the same side with your elbow tucked to your body underneath your wrist.

Step back with the leg on the same side that you are holding the bar on and with control lower yourself down into a lunge position while keeping your core engaged and torso tall, then drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position.
Once your feet are back in the starting position, drive the bar up overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeated for the desired number of reps, then switch sides.

results.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, palms facing each other, and hold it in front of your thighs.

Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and push your hips back, allowing the landmine to travel down your thighs. Lower the landmine by bending forward at the hips while keeping your back flat, allowing the barbell to move closer to the floor. Continue the movement until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your legs relatively straight but with a slight bend in the knees.
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips forward and driving through your heels while keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Rotational Lift To Press
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell with the end of the bar in front of your feet. Squat down and hold the end of the bar with your hand closer to the landmine attachment with your palm facing your body.

Drive your feet into the ground to start the motion. As your legs fully extend, pull the bar upwards with your hand and start to rotate your torso in towards the landmine attachment. As you do so, bring your other hand up to the bar and switch your grip. Press through the bar to extend your arm all the way upright, pivoting your back foot to allow for more trunk rotation.
Perform the movement in reverse to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Setup a landmine with your back on a box.
Lay the end of the bar over your hip.
Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel a contraction, then bring your hips back toward the floor.

results.name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Grab the end of the landmine and stand perpendicular to the bar.
Lift your inside leg and keep your outside leg planted.
Push your hips back keeping your knees mostly extended. When you feel the stretch in your hams, push your hips forward until you are standing upright.

results.name: Landmine Snatch
steps: Hold the end of the bar in front of you.
Pop your hips, pull your elbows up to the ceiling, and get underneath the bar.

results.name: Landmine Squat
steps: Hold the end of the bar in a goblet position.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Reach at least parallel with the ground before pushing through your heels back to the starting position.

results.name: Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand in a staggered position. With the back leg bent and the front mostly extended.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch through your front hamstring.
Push your hips back forward until you are standing.

results.name: Landmine Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance and straddle over the end of the bar.
Bend at the hips and knees, and grab the bar.
Stand up with the bar.

results.name: Landmine Thruster
steps: Hold the bar with a goblet position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the goblet position before starting the next rep.

results.name: Barbell Figure Four Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Barbell Front Squat With Straps
steps: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Wrap a pair of lifting straps around the bar. Hold the ends of the straps. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

results.name: Barbell Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other. Put one foot on a low box or plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Barbell Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Place both feet on a plate or low box. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Bar on your back.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

results.name: Barbell Suitcase Carry
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
Set the bar down and switch sides.

results.name: Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up for a sumo deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
steps: Stand centered over the barbell, feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar with both hands, one in front, one behind.
Lift by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight, then lower slowly.

results.name: Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up for a standard deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, plates should be on blocks, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

results.name: Barbell Deficit Conventional Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, feet should be on a plate or elevated platform, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

results.name: Barbell Muscle Snatch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip, and keep your back straight and core engaged.
Lift the barbell by explosively extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the bar close to your body.
As the bar reaches chest level, rotate your wrists and elbows up and back, transitioning into an overhead press.
Fully extend your arms overhead, stabilize the bar, then lower it back to the starting position with control.

results.name: Barbell High Pull
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.

results.name: Barbell Power Snatch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide (outside shoulders), hook grip recommended.
Keep chest up, back straight, and drive through heels to lift the bar off the ground, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar reaches mid-thigh, explode upwards by extending hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging shoulders and pulling the bar high.
Drop under the bar slightly, catching it overhead with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.

results.name: Barbell Clean And Jerk
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the bar just outside your knees. Pull the bar from the floor by driving through your legs, keeping your back straight.
As the bar reaches your hips, extend explosively, shrug, and drop under to catch it in a front squat position with elbows high. Stand up tall.
Dip slightly, then drive through your legs to push the bar overhead.
Stabilize the bar overhead, lock arms, then bring feet together before lowering the bar safely.

results.name: Barbell Snatch
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, chest up, and back straight.
Lift the bar by driving through your legs, keeping it close to your body. Extend your hips and knees while maintaining a straight back.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar as it moves upward.
Drop into a deep squat while locking the bar overhead. Stabilize, then stand up fully to complete the lift.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.

results.name: Barbell Quad Stomp
steps: Have the barbell in a high bar position and place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

results.name: Barbell Zercher Deficit Lunge
steps: Begin by standing with your feet on a plate and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Step back with one foot off the plate and lower your back knee to the floor.
Push through your front leg and bring your back foot to the plate.

results.name: Barbell Front Rack Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, barbell in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

results.name: Barbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, barbell on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

results.name: Barbell Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, bar on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

results.name: Barbell Clean And Press
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell just outside thighs.
Explosively extend hips and pull bar to shoulders in one motion.
Press overhead until arms lock out, then lower bar under control.

results.name: Barbell Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold bar just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull bar to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.

results.name: Barbell Banded Back Squat
steps: Loop resistance bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push hips back, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels, extend hips and knees, and return to standing tall.

results.name: Barbell Banded Deadlift
steps: Loop bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat, and lower to grasp the bar.
Drive through heels, extend hips and knees, and stand tall with shoulders back.

results.name: Barbell Banded Front Squat
steps: Loop bands under your feet and around the anchors, bar resting on front delts.
Keep chest tall, brace core, and lower until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through midfoot, extend hips and knees, and return to standing upright.

results.name: Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift
steps: Loop bands under your feet or anchors and around the barbell. Stand tall with soft knees.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bar close and back straight throughout.
Squeeze glutes, drive hips forward, and return to full standing position.

results.name: Barbell Banded Split Squat
steps: Loop band under front foot and around barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower back knee toward the floor while keeping front knee over ankle.
Push through front heel and drive up to starting position under control.

results.name: Barbell Thruster
steps: Hold the bar in a front rack position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the front rack position before starting the next rep.

results.name: Barbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold barbell in front rack position and place one foot on the platform.
Drive through the front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

results.name: Barbell Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold barbell on upper back and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

results.name: Trap Bar Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles, stand tall.
Step one foot backward into lunge position.
Lower until front thigh is parallel to ground.
Push through front heel to return standing.

results.name: Trap Bar Split Squat
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

results.name: Trap Bar Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand inside trap bar, lift one foot slightly off ground.
Hinge hips back while lowering bar and extending free leg behind.
Keep hips square and back neutral throughout movement.
Drive through standing foot to return upright.

results.name: Trap Bar Squat
steps: Stand inside trap bar, feet shoulder-width, grip handles.
Sit hips down and back, keeping chest upright.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

results.name: Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand inside trap bar. Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift
steps: Stand on elevated surface inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip handles, brace core, maintain neutral spine.
Drive through feet, extend hips and knees to stand.
Lower under control, maintaining balance on platform.

results.name: Trap Bar Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up inside trap bar with strong brace and neutral spine.
Lift bar slightly, pause just below knees.
Hold tension, then continue to full lockout.
Lower bar slowly back to floor.
